value.rationale: This supplies natural all-period fixed-point and zeta invariants for an entire class of cyclically coupled interval systems, not a finite census or a parameter substitution. The explicit gcd law, finite tensor construction and preservation of rational zeta for arbitrary noninvertible Cournot reactions have mathematical use for periodic-orbit computation. The continuous example exhibits new primitive cycles caused by coupling, whereas entropy alone does not encode the extra factor. The work does not claim paper-sized contribution or general attractor classification.
